description: Return the recorded installation method(s), a ready-to-paste MCP client config (built only from the recorded endpoint or package), package info, transports, auth requirements and source references for a resource. Never fabricates commands: if nothing is recorded, it says so and points to the repository/docs. Accepts a slug, id, name or GitHub owner/repo.

client.description: Target client for a client-specific method, e.g. claude-code, cursor

resource.description: Slug, id, name or GitHub owner/repo of the resource

name: get_installation
title: Get installation instructions
